<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 22</cite> <he>קַטֵּיף … דקְטַפְתְּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00262"><he>עוֹלְלָא</he></cite>. Y. Gitt. III, end, 45ᵇ <he>דאינון קָטְפִין בתר קדימתא וכ׳</he> (not <he>קדמיתא</he>) they cut the grapes after the first east wind after Succoth; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S00764"><he>קְטִיף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>כדון נחירך ק׳ וכ׳</he> now that thy nose is nipped (hanging down like a faded plant), thy ear heavy of hearing &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 25:11">Targ. Y. Lev. XXV, 11</cite>; a. e.—Lam. R. l. c., v. supra.—2) same.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 72b:4">Ab. Zar. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>דקא מְקַטֵּיף קַטּוּפֵי</he> (Rashi <he>דמפסוקי פסוקי</he>, read <he>דמפסיק</he>) he breaks off (the connection of the flow, withdraws the pouring vessel before the jet reaches the vessel into which the wine is poured).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 72b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>קַטְּפוּ קטופי</he> (not <he>קטפי</he>; Ar. ed. Koh. <he>קטיפתו</he>) interrupt you the flow!
